French = modern spelling (obvious slips and old spellings corrected without marks in the app); each message keeps the printed text in orig.fr (data only, not shown). en · ko translated from the French for this app. Sexual lines and battle reports are left out (see excerpt). Replies and talks are written by this app, not by the recipients.

note.ko: 1796년 9월, 보나파르트는 만토바를 에워싼 채 베로나에 머물렀어요. 조제핀은 여름부터 밀라노에 와 있었지만 둘은 거의 만나지 못했어요. 그는 ‘못됐다, 못생겼다’ 하며 장난스럽게 투정을 부리고, 어느 날 밤 문을 박차고 들어가겠다고 해요. 날짜 줄의 ‘보충일 첫날’은 공화력에서 한 해 끝에 붙는 닷새 가운데 첫날이에요.
note.en: In September 1796 Bonaparte was at Verona, besieging Mantua. Joséphine had been in Milan since the summer, but they hardly saw each other. He teases her (‘naughty’, ‘ugly’) and threatens to burst through her door one night. The ‘first complementary day’ in the date line is the first of the five extra days at the end of the Republican year.

messages.fr: La fièvre et un violent mal de tête, tout cela m'a empêché d'écrire à mon adorable amie ; mais j'ai reçu ses lettres, je les ai pressées contre mon cœur et mes lèvres, et la douleur de l'absence, cent milles d'éloignement, ont disparu.
messages.en: Fever and a violent headache: all that kept me from writing to my adorable love. But I received her letters, I pressed them to my heart and my lips, and the pain of absence, a hundred miles of distance, disappeared.

note.ko: ‘이제 하나도 안 사랑해’로 시작하지만 끝은 ‘얼른 네 쪽 써 줘’예요. 중간에 tu(너)에서 vous(부인)로 바꿔 부르며 일부러 거리를 두는데, 화났다는 장난스러운 몸짓이에요. 한국어도 그 대목만 높임말로 옮겼어요. cendrillon(신데렐라)은 그 시절 ‘부엌데기, 칠칠맞은 아이’라는 뜻으로도 썼어요.
note.en: It begins ‘I don't love you at all anymore’ and ends ‘write me four pages, quickly’. In the middle he switches from tu to the formal vous (‘madame’) to keep her at a mock distance, a playful show of anger; the Korean uses polite speech for that passage. Cendrillon (Cinderella) was also used then for a kitchen drudge, a scatterbrained girl.

note.en: Written at Tolentino on the day peace was signed with Pope Pius VI. The terms of the treaty (territory, money, works of art) are left out.
